name: AI-powered natural language CMS (built with Enferno)

mentions.name: AI-powered natural language CMS (built with Enferno)
mentions.description: A content management system that replaces traditional form-based content editing with natural language interaction, letting users manage content by describing what they want in plain language. It is AI-powered and built with the Enferno framework.
mentions.problem: Traditional CMSs require filling out forms to manage content.
